skills.name: monl-commerce
skills.description: Build complete premium commerce and marketplace interfaces for Monl. Use when a contract contains products, listings, prices, stock, carts, orders, purchases, payments, fulfillment, delivery, sellers, or buyers.
skills.description_zh: 为 Monl 创建完整的商业和交易市场界面，适用于契约中包含产品、商品条目、价格、库存、购物车、订单、支付、履约、配送和买卖双方的应用。

skills.name: monl-design-system
skills.description: Turn a validated Monl contract into a concrete design system before frontend implementation, with page patterns, tokens, asset planning, anti-patterns, accessibility and delivery gates.
headings: Build from the Monl design system
skills.description_zh: 在前端实施前，把已验证的 Monl 契约转成具体设计系统，规定页面模式、设计 token、素材计划、反模式、无障碍及交付关卡。

skills.name: monl-operations
skills.description: Build professional operational workspaces for Monl. Use for dashboards, inventory, finance, task management, moderation, community administration, reporting, approval queues, and other multi-entity role-based applications.
skills.description_zh: 为 Monl 构建运营工作区，覆盖看板、库存、财务、任务、内容审核、社区管理、报表和审批队列等多实体、按角色组织的应用。

skills.name: monl-showcase
skills.description: Build or refine dense, distinctive, demo-grade Monl web interfaces. Use for every public-facing Monl frontend, showcase project, design upgrade, or frontend quality review that must preserve the generated API contract while reaching production-level polish.
skills.description_zh: 创建或提升面向公众的 Monl Web 界面、演示项目和设计质量，在保留生成 API 契约的前提下完善界面细节并开展前端质量审查。

skills.name: monl-spec
skills.description: Décrire une application en spécification monl (.ml), la compiler en backend FastAPI + SQLite + JWT déterministe, et la vérifier contre un vrai serveur. À utiliser quand on demande de créer, modifier ou vérifier le backend d'une application avec monl, ou d'écrire/corriger un fichier .ml.
headings: Écrire et compiler une spécification monl
2. Apprendre le langage sur les exemples, pas de mémoire
3. Écrire la spec dans le projet de l'utilisateur
skills.description_zh: 用 monl 的 .ml 规格描述应用，确定性编译为 FastAPI、SQLite 和 JWT 后端，并对真实服务器验证；用于创建、修改、检查后端或编写修正 .ml 文件。

skills.name: monl-ui-patterns
skills.description: Compose Monl frontends from local, autonomous UI patterns inspired by component registries, without importing React, Tailwind, CDNs or invented business behavior.
skills.description_zh: 以本地独立 UI 模式组合 Monl 前端，参考组件注册库的思路，避免引入 React、Tailwind、CDN 或臆造业务行为。
